scope: Primary-source freshness check of default-branch metadata plus selected official README/DFlash integration/support-matrix pages only. No code audit, install, model download or inference.

findings: README advertises continuous batching and tiered hot-RAM/cold-SSD KV with prefix sharing and copy-on-write.
README lists DFlash-MLX as a related project and Lightning MTP/MTPLX references; detailed DFlash behavior is documented in the separately inspected integration page.
DFlash is described as running inside BatchedEngine/VLMBatchedEngine and using the scheduler, continuous batching and paged hot/SSD prefix cache.
Table lists Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6/Qwen3.8 text/VLM families with concurrent-row support; the prose limits actual speculation to single-row requests because multi-row ragged rollback is not supported.
Adaptive verify mode lets Lightning MTP depth controllers use measured cost and acceptance; off and full-block modes are also listed.
DFlash is described as mutually exclusive with Lightning MTP, VLM MTP and expert offload.

repositories.directly_relevant_oNPU_gaps: The inspected current oNPU comparison describes one active request per worker and a recent RAM prefix cache, with continuous batching and shared paged/SSD KV as gaps. The inspected oMLX DFlash page advertises scheduler-integrated batched serving and a paged hot/SSD prefix cache for DFlash requests. This is a source-feature comparison only, not an implementation or performance equivalence claim.

repositories.commit_subject: docs(tokenspeed): add the TP8 row measured on 0.1.2

findings: Matrix sections are released 0.1.0, 0.1.1, current released 0.1.2, and unreleased candidates.
The matrix describes 0.1.2 runs on NVIDIA B300 with named engines/configurations; rows from unreleased candidates are kept separate.
The default measured pair in the matrix is Qwen3.8-27B with its EAGLE-4 draft. Nemotron 3.5 Super 120B-A12B also has a named section.
The new-head commit subject concerns a TokenSpeed TP8 0.1.2 row.
No Qwen3.5-2B-target-compatible EAGLE-4 draft is named in this inspected support matrix. This is scoped to this matrix, not a global absence claim.

repositories.small_pair_finding: No compatible small 2B target/draft pair appears in the inspected current support matrix; do not infer that no such draft exists elsewhere.
